# Shaun Vincent

> UI/UX and visual designer based in Winnipeg, Canada. Personal portfolio site covering services, selected work, professional background, and contact.

Shaun Vincent is a UI/UX designer and marketing creative, currently Marketing Manager at Paragon Living and co-owner/creative director at Side Lane Studio. Open to select freelance work in UI/UX design, branding, marketing creative, and web development/automation.
